'''Level 42''' was a level of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] on which the establishment [[Kuzbar's Cantina]] was situated.<ref name="TF" /> In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mander Zuma]] and his associates [[Reen Irana]] and [[Eddey Be'ray]] ventured to Level 42 while investigating the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Tempest (spice)|tempest]].<ref name="Scourge">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref>
